keys.description: Flat map keyed by the full dotted section.key string, byte-for-byte identical to how a $(section.key) reference names it. No nested tree — see DECISIONS.md for the [cascade]/[cascade.loop] sibling-section collision that rules a nested tree out.

layers.description: Ordered, depth-first-flattened assignments to this key. Must be an array (not a map) because last-write-wins is order-dependent and JSON object key order is not part of the JSON spec.

condition.description: Flat, ANDed array of predicates. Nesting depth is array length; no wrapper key.

node.description: A value is a single recursive node: literal | env | ref | concat. Dispatch on 'type'.

text.description: .pfcfg has no type system beyond text; a literal is always the raw string as written (post quote-unescaping), never coerced to bool/number.

envNode.description: default = ${VAR:-default}; alt = ${VAR:+alternate}; neither = bare ${VAR}. Mutually exclusive because a single ${...} token is one legacy form or the other, never both.

path.description: Copied byte-for-byte from the $(...) text. Referential integrity (does this key exist) is deliberately NOT enforced here — that's a runtime resolution concern for the evaluator, not a shape property.

parts.description: A single part is never wrapped in concat; it's just that node directly. Enforced here so a converter bug can't silently emit a 1-item concat.
